summary: Onboarding email CTA links to deprecated Console route (404) after routing change
description:
Issue Summary
Customer reports that onboarding email CTA links ("Open Console", "View setup checklist") lead to a 404 page in Console. This blocks users from reaching the intended activation flow and is likely impacting activation rate during the lifecycle growth experiments sprint.

Customer Impact
- New signups cannot land on the intended Console setup page from onboarding emails.
- Creates confusion and reduces trust (looks like a broken product).
- Workaround exists (navigate directly to https://console.redwoodinference.com after sign-in), but customer may not discover it.

Customer Report (verbatim excerpt)
"Tried clicking the setup link in your email and it goes to a 404. I can log into the console fine, but the link is broken."

Environment
- Console: prod (web)
- Reproduced across Chrome 121 + Safari 17
- Reproduced from Gmail web + iOS mail

Steps to Reproduce
1) Create a new self-serve account (or use any account that receives onboarding emails).
2) Open onboarding email: "Welcome to Redwood Inference" (CTA: "Open Console")
3) Click CTA.
4) Observe 404 in Console.

Expected Result
CTA should deep-link the user to the current onboarding destination (setup checklist / getting started page) OR gracefully redirect to the closest valid route.

Actual Result
CTA deep-links to deprecated route and returns 404.

Observed URL Patterns
- From email (broken): https://console.redwoodinference.com/app/projects/new?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lifecycle_welcome
- Alternate broken link observed in the 2nd email variant: https://console.redwoodinference.com/app/onboarding/checklist?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lifecycle_first_success

Notes / Initial Investigation
- Regression aligns with recent Console routing updates for the activation checklist + banner placements.
- Console appears to have moved from /app/* routes to a newer router structure (or tightened route matching) without redirects.
- UTMs present; issue is not caused by query params (404 persists without UTMs).

Support Triage Checklist
- Confirmed customer can access Console directly: YES
- Confirmed 404 only occurs via deep link: YES
- Confirmed affects multiple email variants: YES (welcome + first-success)
- Confirmed not an auth/SSO issue: YES

Workaround
Advise customer to:
1) Visit https://console.redwoodinference.com
2) Sign in
3) Navigate to "Getting started" / dashboard manually

Requested Fix
1) Add redirects from deprecated /app/* deep links to the new canonical routes.
2) Update onboarding email templates to point to the new canonical routes.
3) Add a lightweight link-check step to the email launch checklist (pre-send smoke test in prod).

Attachments
- Customer screenshot of 404 page (received via email; attached in Zendesk case ZD-77124; not included here)
- Internal repro screenshot (see #support thread 2025-01-23)

Internal References
- Growth sprint context: onboarding email sequence v1 + Console onboarding nudges v1
